_note: The WiFi station of examples/c6-wifi-station, the committed CI build (console only, on USB-Serial/JTAG; licences in public/wifi-station-NOTICE.txt), on a bare ESP32-C6. Two joinable virtual access points (the CLI's two --wifi) and three networks around them (--wifi-nearby): the scan lists all five, the station joins esp32sim with WPA2, takes its DHCP lease and pings the gateway five times. The Network panel opens on the station's Ethernet frames (--pcap's, live). No NAT on the page: the gateway is as far as it goes.
